read.en: Lumentum fell 7.9% on Nov 4 to $626.75, trading between $598.78 and $650.62 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($750.3), 10-day ($785.9), 30-day ($909.9) and 100-day ($861.8) averages and the rising 200-day ($806.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening sharply; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($960.21), and RSI is 31.6.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月4日下跌 7.9%，收于 $626.75，盘中区间 $598.78–650.62，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$750.3）、10 日（$785.9）、30 日（$909.9）和 100 日均线（$861.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$806.0）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图明显扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$960.21），RSI 为 31.6。

read.en: The close broke the $667.4 and $650–651 supports (Nov 3 low, July lows), now resistance; the $650.6 high stopped right at them. The $598.8 low tested the $594.8–602.3 late-July lows and held. Resistance is $650–651, then $667.3 and $679–683. Support is $594.8–602.3, then $550. A close above $651 would target $667–683; below $594.8, $550.
